address: 3F, The Mira Hotel, 118 Nathan Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: The striking chandelier with hundreds of glowing glass globes is set nicely against the calming green colour scheme and verdant views. Cantonese classics underpinned by solid, traditional techniques are revitalised by creative use of ingredients and modern twists. On top of special dim sum such as crispy frog legs with peppered salt, try also Mrs. Song’s fish soup made with fresh grouper fillet. Wine pairings are thoughtfully matched....
